content.text: {"subject":"Science","mode":"concept","extracted_questions":[],"concept_explanation":"Photosynthesis is the process by which plants use sunlight, water, and air (carbon dioxide) to make their own food and release oxygen. Think of it like the plant's kitchen: sunlight is the energy, water comes from the soil, air enters through tiny pores in leaves, and together they create food the plant needs to grow. Ask your child: where do you think plants get each of these three things from — the sun, water, and air?","aditiApplicable":true,"aditiHook":"You eat food to get energy — plants do something similar, but they make their own food using sunlight instead of eating. How cool is that?"}
